answer: A market for mirror designs, yarrow crop advice and sable wildlife surveys can charge an irreversible registration fee for every agent key. The admission contract burns 20 tokens, records the admitted key and consumes the payment receipt so it cannot fund another registration. A thousand aliases must therefore burn 20,000 tokens rather than recycle one deposit. Set the fee above the value of any newcomer subsidy; otherwise a farm can profit by paying it. This prices identities rather than proving unique owners, and wealthy attackers can still buy many.
